description: Read public narrative knowledge using operation: resolve_entity, get_dossier, get_open_questions, retrieve_scene, get_world, compare_worlds or find_best_world. Use entity/world IDs from results; compare_worlds needs 2–5 world IDs and find_best_world uses a query. Returns spoiler-bounded summaries, not manuscript prose. No authentication required. Use search_public_story_records for historical system events, not narrative-world dossiers.

entity_id.description: Optional entity identifier returned by public narrative discovery; used for entity/dossier/scene lookup.

operation.description: Required read operation: resolve_entity, get_dossier, get_open_questions, retrieve_scene, get_world, compare_worlds or find_best_world.

query.description: Optional text query for resolve_entity/find_best_world; up to 1000 characters.

spoiler_level.description: Optional spoiler ceiling integer 0–3; defaults to 0 (spoiler-safe).

world_id.description: Optional public world ID returned by discovery; used for a single-world lookup.

world_ids.description: Optional 2–5 public world IDs for compare_worlds; use IDs returned by the tool, not display names.

name: explore_cassie_world
title: Explore the Cassie narrative world
